name: Sangoku Hime 4 ~Tenka Ryouran Tenmei no Koi Emaki~
original_name: 三極姫4 ～天華繚乱 天命の恋絵巻～
source:
Countless man-made and natural disasters have driven people mad and the continent into chaos. In the midst of the Yellow Turban rebellion, a few brave warriors declared their desires to take supremacy over the nation. Akito is a young man, wandering in search of his purpose in life. Only he has a mysterious ability – a kind heart unbefitting of these troubled times.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/09/01/september-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
无数人为人为与自然灾害逼疯，大陆陷入混乱。在黄巾之乱中，一些勇敢的战士宣称要争夺天下霸权。年轻的晓人为了寻找人生目标四处漂泊。只有他拥有一种神秘能力——一颗不属于这个乱世的善良之心。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/09/01/september-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau～Omochikaeri！[/url]]
